title: From the Sun to a survey field
description: Three catalog stops: the Sun, Andromeda, and 3C 273, with distance sources and a Legacy Surveys DR11 image.

steps.title: Start at the Sun
steps.body: The Sun is the origin of this heliocentric map. It has no measured distance from itself.

steps.title: Andromeda in the Messier catalog
steps.body: The loaded Messier snapshot places Andromeda at approximately 3 million light-years. This is a catalog estimate.

sentences.text: The Messier catalog estimate for Andromeda is
. The source chip opens the record; this is an estimate, not an exact distance.

steps.title: 3C 273 and the DR11 field
steps.body: 3C 273 has a redshift-derived comoving distance. The DR11 cutout is an angular image seen from Earth and does not measure its distance.

sentences.text: The SIMBAD redshift model places 3C 273 at
comoving distance. This is not a lookback time or a luminosity distance.
The model uses H0=67.8 km/s/Mpc, matter density 0.308, and dark-energy density 0.692. The image is an Earth-view angular field.
